scope: Same RGB matches for every camera condition; no match selection or camera adjustment from GT
mesh_limitations: First-hit geometry does not model descriptor support, antialiasing, or view-dependent texture/shading. No-hit/occluded/outside/invalid matches are not called correct.

protocol.scope: RGB-only correspondence availability diagnostic; frozen spatial validation; no camera correction or new-object claim
protocol.split_scope: First-image spatial cells are indivisible, including duplicate orientation keypoints. Target-cell overlap is reported. This is a correspondence holdout, not independent images or objects.
limitations: Target strips only are excluded, not every rod or foreground object
Descriptor support can cross mask boundaries
F/H validation consistency cannot establish physical correspondence or calibrated pose
Sampson and homography transfer residuals have different meanings
No DA3, GT, or previous heldout RGB is read by fit
No thresholds change after pilot scores

omitted_arrays: Per-match residuals and training masks only; original pair/mesh paths and hashes retained. All pairs, camera conditions, subsets, counts, models and aggregate metrics retained.
